Requirement 2 (Issue #11854: Turn submit button in `st.chat_input` into stop button)
Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. Summary In ChatGPT and many other apps, the submit button in the chat input turns into a stop button after submitting. Clicking it interrupts the current LLM generation/streaming. We should have the same thing! Why? Today, there's no way to interrupt an LLM generation in a Streamlit app. That can be annoying for long LLM messages. How? After submitting a message, the submit button should turn into a stop button. Clicking it should interrupt the current run, maybe simply by calling st.stop under the hood? Requirement 3 (Issue #11980: Ability to Set Default Sidebar Width)
Checklist - [x] I have searched the existing issues for similar feature requests. - [x] I added a descriptive title and summary to this issue. Summary Add the ability to configure the default sidebar width in config.toml. Why? The default sidebar width was changed in Streamlit 1.46.0, which can affects apps that rely on a wider sidebar for layout consistency. In my case, I have buttons and other elements in the sidebar that now appear squished with the new default. While it’s possible to override the sidebar width using custom HTML like: [data-testid="stSidebar"] { width: 400px; } or [data-testid="stSidebar"] { min-width: 400px; max-width: 800px; } this approach has limitations.
